name: pdf4me
summary: PDF4me PDF suite SDK for Python: convert HTML, URL, Markdown, Word, Excel and images to and from PDF; merge, split, compress, rotate, OCR, PDF/A; e-sign, protect, unlock; create and fill PDF forms; find and replace text; hyperlink annotations, text coordinates, highlighting; Word tracked changes; image resize, crop, watermark, EXIF; barcodes, SwissQR and EPC QR codes; ZUGFeRD e-invoices; document generation; AI extraction from invoices, receipts, contracts, bank statements, tax documents and pay stubs.
